summary: Defines a new SIP header field, Feature-Caps, which carries feature-capability indicators showing support for features and capabilities of SIP entities not identified by the URI of the Contact header field. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: It is a name tag listing what each helper in a phone call can do, so others know what to ask for.

questions: what is the sip feature-caps header
how to indicate sip capabilities of proxies
